intents.official_summary: Ask the mayor to send an anniversary message to couples celebrating a 50th, 55th, 60th, 65th, 70th, or 75th anniversary.

Requesting an anniversary certificate from the mayor

intents.official_summary: Requests for maintenance of guiderails, retaining walls, fences, or railings.
example_utterances: The guardrail on the highway is bent and damaged
A railing along the walkway is loose and dangerous
The retaining wall is starting to collapse
Fence beside the road has been knocked down

disambiguation.request-repairs: Barrier in the road right-of-way; park/playground equipment repairs go to request-repairs.

intents.official_summary: Ask the mayor to send a birthday message to someone turning 80, 90, or 100 (also available every year after 100).
example_utterances: My grandmother is turning 100, can the mayor send a birthday message
Requesting a birthday greeting from the mayor

intents.official_summary: Book one of the municipality’s beautiful venues for your wedding. Indoor and outdoor options available.
example_utterances: I want to book a park for my wedding ceremony
How do I reserve an outdoor venue for a wedding

intents.official_summary: Report on damaged headstones, fallen over headstones, grave depressions, or general cemetery inquiries. HRM Owned cemeteries only.
example_utterances: A headstone has fallen over in the municipal cemetery
There's a depression over a grave that needs filling
The gravestone is damaged and leaning

intents.display_name: Community Clean Up / Adopt A Highway
intents.official_summary: Schedule pick up from Community Clean Up programs. Please ensure you have registered for the program prior to contacting HRM
example_utterances: We finished our community cleanup, can you pick up the bags
Our Adopt-A-Highway group needs a collection scheduled

disambiguation.report-street-litter: Organized/registered cleanup program pickup, not a litter report.

intents.note: Requester must already be registered in the program.

intents.official_summary: Requests for new crosswalks, crosswalk repairs, or crosswalk painting.
example_utterances: The crosswalk paint is completely faded and drivers don't stop
We need a crosswalk at this intersection, it's dangerous
The crosswalk flashing lights aren't working

disambiguation.pavement-markings: Crosswalk specifically; other road markings (lines, arrows, stop bars) go to pavement-markings.
disambiguation.traffic-signals: Pedestrian crosswalk; full traffic signals go to traffic-signals.

intents.official_summary: Requests for repairs on curbs or gutters
example_utterances: The curb outside my house is crumbling
Gutter along the street is broken
Curb was damaged by a truck

disambiguation.walking-surface-maintenance: Curb/gutter specifically, not the sidewalk surface.
disambiguation.snow-damage: If a snow plow caused it, use snow-damage.

intents.official_summary: Report issues on deceased animals or marine life on HRM Property, including parks, playgrounds, and fields.
example_utterances: There's a dead raccoon on the side of the road
A deer was hit by a car and is lying in the ditch
Dead bird in the playground
There's a dead seal washed up on the beach

disambiguation.problem-plants-insects-invasive-species: Animal is dead; living nuisance animals go to problem-plants-insects-invasive-species.

slot_extraction.animal_type: Map the mentioned animal to the `animal_type` dropdown (Bird, Cat, Deer, Dog, Marine Life, Raccoon, Other Animal, Unknown).

intents.official_summary: Report issues related to repair or maintenance of drainage assets (where flooding is not currently happening). Examples include culverts, ditch, street drains, catch basins, other.
example_utterances: The catch basin grate is broken and needs repair
A culvert under my driveway has collapsed
The ditch needs cleaning out, it's full of silt
Storm drain cover is loose

disambiguation.flooding-requests: Repair/maintenance where flooding is NOT currently happening.
disambiguation.drainage-infrastructure-request: Repair of EXISTING drainage; a request for NEW drainage goes to drainage-infrastructure-request.

intents.official_summary: Request for new drainage infrastructure (e.g. new catch basin, culvert, street drain).
example_utterances: We need a new catch basin on this corner, water always pools
Can you install a culvert under our driveway

intents.official_summary: Report concerns on the size of election signs, signs in prohibited areas, signs on a travel way, path, or other concerns.
example_utterances: There are campaign signs blocking the sidewalk
An election sign is in a prohibited area
Political signs are too big and blocking sight lines

intents.official_summary: Report active incidents of flooding; catch basins, water running into the street, culverts and ditches.
example_utterances: The street is flooding, water is up to the curb
A catch basin is blocked and water is pooling
Water is running down the road into my driveway
The ditch is overflowing onto the street

disambiguation.drainage-infrastructure-maintenance-or-r: ACTIVE flooding happening now. If water is not currently flooding and it's an asset repair, use drainage-infrastructure-maintenance-or-repair.

intents.urgency: Active flooding is time-sensitive; flag as high priority.

intents.official_summary: Requests to have graffiti removed.
example_utterances: Someone spray painted graffiti on the underpass
There's tagging all over the bus shelter
The wall by the park has been defaced with graffiti
Can you remove the spray paint from the fence

intents.official_summary: Requests to cut grass in parks, playgrounds, athletic fields, cemeteries and in the boulevard.
example_utterances: The grass in the park hasn't been cut all summer
Can you mow the boulevard in front of my house
Long grass on the sports field needs cutting
The lawn at the cemetery is overgrown

disambiguation.vegetation-maintenance: Grass cutting only; brush and overgrowth go to vegetation-maintenance.
disambiguation.landscaping: Beds and shrubs go to landscaping.

intents.official_summary: View recent information about HRFE fire calls and incidents in one place.
example_utterances: Where can I see recent fire department calls
intents.note: Informational feed, not a submittable request.

intents.official_summary: Report illegally parked vehicles.
example_utterances: A car is blocking my driveway and I can't get out
Someone parked in the accessible spot without a permit
There's a vehicle parked on the sidewalk
Car has been parked in front of my house for a week
Someone is double parked and blocking traffic
A truck is parked in the fire lane

disambiguation.obstructions: A parked VEHICLE. Debris, carts or other objects go to obstructions.
disambiguation.parking-permits: A complaint, not a permit application.

slot_extraction.alleged_violation: Map to the `alleged_violation` dropdown. Options flagged (DISPATCH) are urgent and trigger immediate dispatch.

intents.urgency: Options marked (DISPATCH) — blocking driveway, fire lane on public property, on sidewalk, near hydrant/crosswalk/stop sign — are high priority.

intents.official_summary: Invite the mayor to attend your special event.
example_utterances: We'd like to invite the mayor to our community festival
Can the mayor speak at our opening ceremony

intents.official_summary: Requests for pruning and maintenance of foliage, vegetation, shrubs, flower beds, hanging baskets. Examples include weeds in shrub beds, rodent holes, etc.
example_utterances: The flower beds downtown need weeding
Hanging baskets on the street look dead
Shrubs in the median need pruning
There are rodent holes in the shrub bed

intents.official_summary: Lighting requests for HRM owned sports fields, sports courts, ball diamonds, all-weather fields and courts. Includes HRM owned parks, playgrounds, cemeteries, open spaces and walkways.
example_utterances: The lights on the ball diamond aren't turning on
Playground lighting is broken at the community park
Can you turn on the lights at the tennis court
The lights along the park walkway are out

disambiguation.street-lighting-concerns: Lighting on municipal PARK / field / playground property, not a street.

intents.official_summary: Ask the mayor to send a congratulatory message to someone retiring from the military.
example_utterances: A colleague is retiring from the navy, can the mayor send congratulations

intents.display_name: New Litter Bin in Park Request

keywords: need a bin in the park
example_utterances: Can you put a garbage can in the playground area
We need a litter bin at the park entrance

disambiguation.new-litter-bin-row-request: Bin located in a PARK; a bin on a street/sidewalk goes to new-litter-bin-row-request.
disambiguation.report-park-litter: Requesting a NEW bin, not reporting existing litter.

intents.display_name: New Litter Bin in ROW Request
intents.official_summary: Request for new litterbins in the right-of-way.

We need a litter bin on the sidewalk here

disambiguation.new-litter-bin-park-request: Bin in the right-of-way (street/sidewalk); a bin in a park goes to new-litter-bin-park-request.

intents.official_summary: Request for new sidewalks.
example_utterances: There is no sidewalk on our street and kids walk on the road
Can you build a sidewalk along this stretch
We need a new sidewalk installed on Main Street

disambiguation.walking-surface-maintenance: NEW construction request, not repair of an existing sidewalk.

Can you put a stop light at this corner

disambiguation.traffic-signals: NEW signal request, not a malfunction.
disambiguation.traffic-calming: If the concern is speeding, use traffic-calming.

intents.official_summary: Request for a new sign in a park (sign maintenance, complaints about signs in a park -including election signs).

disambiguation.row-signage: Sign located in a PARK, not the street right-of-way.

intents.official_summary: Report anything impeding the flow of traffic or pedestrians such as MVA debris (including fluids from the vehicle), garbage bags, temporary signs, shopping carts.

Shopping carts dumped in the middle of the bike lane
Something is blocking the sidewalk and people can't get by
Garbage bags left on the roadway

disambiguation.report-street-litter: Something IMPEDING traffic or pedestrians; scattered litter goes to report-street-litter.

intents.official_summary: Inquire about parking permits (inquiry/complaint).
example_utterances: I need to apply for a residential parking permit
How do I get a parking permit for my street

intents.official_summary: Inquire about getting a photo of when your ticket was issued. This is not to be used for FOIPOP requests, Disclosure requests, or if your ticket has already been paid.
example_utterances: I want the photo evidence for my parking ticket
Can I see the picture taken when I got ticketed

intents.official_summary: Inquiries on, or request for a new park, playground, greenspace, or infrastructure.

We'd like a bench installed along the trail

disambiguation.row-bench: Bench in a PARK; a bench on the street right-of-way goes to row-bench.

intents.official_summary: Parks related inquiries, including complaints & compliments, hours of operation, policy inquiries, lost items in parks.

Who do I talk to about park opening hours

disambiguation.parks-infrastructure-requests: General inquiry; requests for park equipment/infrastructure go to parks-infrastructure-requests.

intents.official_summary: Request for new pavement markings or repainting of existing markings.

Can you repaint the centre line on our road
The stop bar at the intersection has faded away

disambiguation.crosswalks: General road markings; crosswalks go to crosswalks.

intents.display_name: Problem Plants, Insects, or Invasive Species
intents.official_summary: Report issues with problem plants, bugs, or invasive species.

Japanese knotweed is spreading in the park
A wasp nest on municipal property near the playground
I found ticks in the park grass
European fire ants all over the boulevard

disambiguation.trees: Species/pest problem, not general tree maintenance.
disambiguation.deceased-animals: Living pest/plant problem; a dead animal goes to deceased-animals.

slot_extraction.species: Map the named plant/insect to the `species` dropdown value.

intents.official_summary: Register an alarm for a residence or business.
example_utterances: I need to register my home security alarm
How do I register a commercial alarm system

slot_extraction.this_registration_is_for: Residential property owner / Commercial property owner / Business owner / Tenant.

example_utterances: There's a huge pothole on Robie Street that nearly blew my tire
A sinkhole opened up in the middle of my street
The road surface is falling apart near the intersection
Big hole in the pavement outside my house, cars are swerving
Can someone fix the crater on Quinpool Road

disambiguation.walking-surface-maintenance: Pothole = roadway/driving surface. If the damage is on a SIDEWALK or walkway, use walking-surface-maintenance.
disambiguation.utility-related-street-cuts-trenches: If the hole is a utility trench/cut left by a contractor, use utility-related-street-cuts-trenches.

intents.display_name: Report a problem with a streetlight
intents.official_summary: Report an issue with a streetlight on a municipal street, park, or open space.
example_utterances: The streetlight in front of my house has been out for two weeks
Street lamp is flickering all night
Our whole street is dark, the lights aren't working
Burnt out light on the corner of Agricola and North

disambiguation.lights-parks-playground-fields: Street/roadway lighting. Lighting in a PARK, playground, sports field or court goes to lights-parks-playground-fields.

Trash left on the sports field
The playground is covered in litter

disambiguation.report-street-litter: Park/field; streets and sidewalks go to report-street-litter.

intents.display_name: Report litter on streets or sidewalks
intents.official_summary: Report litter or overflowing waste bins on municipal streets, sidewalks, paths, walkways, between streets or in ditches.

Someone dumped trash bags on the street corner
Lots of litter along the roadside

disambiguation.report-park-litter: Street or sidewalk; litter in a PARK or field goes to report-park-litter.
disambiguation.new-litter-bin-row-request: A cleanup request, not a request for a new bin.

A slide in the park is cracked and unsafe
The bench in the park is falling apart

disambiguation.parks-infrastructure-requests: REPAIR of existing equipment, not a new installation.

intents.official_summary: Requests for new ROW Benches or Bench Repairs.
example_utterances: Can we get a bench at this bus stop
The bench on the sidewalk is damaged

Who is responsible for maintaining this road
intents.note: Catch-all fallback for right-of-way questions that match no specific intent.

intents.official_summary: Request for new ROW/Traffic signs, damage to signs, missing signs, sign maintenance, change or removal of traffic signs.
keywords: need a sign on the street
example_utterances: Can you install a no-parking sign on this block
We'd like a children-at-play sign on our street

disambiguation.street-sign-missing-or-damaged: NEW sign request in the right-of-way.
disambiguation.non-row-signage: Signs in a park go to non-row-signage.

intents.official_summary: Report damage to HRM Property such as vehicles, buildings, sidewalks, curbs, grass, trees, shrubs, gardens, etc.

Plow damaged the edge of my driveway

disambiguation.walking-surface-maintenance: Damage specifically caused by winter/plow operations.

intents.official_summary: Report missing or damaged street signs.
example_utterances: The stop sign at the corner has been knocked down

disambiguation.row-signage: Missing/damaged sign report. A request for a NEW sign in the right-of-way goes to row-signage.
disambiguation.non-row-signage: Signs in a PARK go to non-row-signage.
disambiguation.election-signs: Election campaign signs go to election-signs.

intents.official_summary: Requests for street sweeping outside of regularly scheduled weekly sweeping (during warmer months).

Can you send a street sweeper, there's gravel everywhere

disambiguation.report-street-litter: Sweeping of sand/dirt/gravel, not litter pickup.

intents.official_summary: Requests for traffic calming measures.
example_utterances: Cars speed down our residential street all day
Can we get speed bumps installed, it's not safe for kids
Drivers are racing through the neighbourhood

disambiguation.new-traffic-signal-request: Speed/traffic calming concern, not a signal request.

intents.official_summary: Maintenance or repair of traffic signals. This includes flashing lights, stuck lights, lights out, audible crosswalk signal chirping, snow covered traffic heads, etc.
example_utterances: The traffic light at the intersection is stuck on red
Traffic signal is completely dark, it's dangerous
The light timing is too short to cross
Pedestrian button isn't working at the signal

disambiguation.new-traffic-signal-request: Problem with an EXISTING signal; asking for a new one goes to new-traffic-signal-request.
disambiguation.street-lighting-concerns: Traffic control signal, not a streetlight.

intents.official_summary: Request work pertaining to tree pruning, tree removal, tree planting, and stump removal, and/or report tree vandalism (illegal cuts or pruning).
example_utterances: A tree fell down across the sidewalk
There's a dead tree that looks like it might fall on my house
Branches are hanging over the road and hitting buses
Can someone trim the tree in front of my property
Big limb broke off in the storm and is blocking the path

disambiguation.vegetation-maintenance: Trees specifically. General brush/overgrowth along the right-of-way goes to vegetation-maintenance.
disambiguation.landscaping: Shrubs, flower beds and ornamental planting go to landscaping.
disambiguation.problem-plants-insects-invasive-species: If it is an invasive/noxious plant or an insect problem, use problem-plants-insects-invasive-species.

intents.official_summary: Change your address on your tax bill.
keywords: update my mailing address for taxes
example_utterances: I moved and need to update my mailing address for property tax
Change of address for my tax bill

intents.display_name: Utility Related Street Cuts and Trenches

disambiguation.report-a-pothole: Damage from a utility cut/trench, not a natural pothole.

intents.official_summary: Report on vegetation causing line of site issues, or vegetation in the right-of-way impeding the flow of traffic or pedestrians.

Vegetation is growing over the sidewalk

disambiguation.landscaping: Ornamental beds, shrubs and hanging baskets go to landscaping.

intents.official_summary: Requests for maintenance of sidewalks, pedestrian ramps at intersections/crosswalks, tactile plates, street to street walkways, marked crosswalks or stairs.

The walkway in front of my building is a trip hazard
